jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Placement Programme
jobs.description:
TJX Europe
At TJX Europe, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritises your development. Whether you’re working in our Distribution Centers, Corporate Offices, or Retail Stores—TK Maxx & Homesense, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX team—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:
Please only apply to this role if you are studying on a course that requires you to undertake an industrial placement for 12 months

About the Program

Continuous improvement is a  business strategy that involves the evaluation and revision of processes, methods and practices. The goal of continuous improvement is to make periodic changes to increase the efficiency, accuracy and effectiveness of business operations using key tools from Lean Six Sigma.
What You’ll Do
As a 12 month placement, your main responsibilities will include:
- You’ll be participating in process improvement projects, leveraging Lean Six Sigma (LSS) methodology, including scoping, defining, prioritizing projects, identifying project metrics, developing control plans to ensure project delivers gains that are continuous and sustainable with results that are measurable and validated developing pilot plans as needed.

- You’ll be responsible for supporting research that identifies improvement opportunities, including identifying, testing, and developing and implementing sustainable improvement strategies to improve productivity and efficiencies that supports current and future business needs.

- You’ll provide planning support using DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyse, Improve, Control) project roadmap includes identifying project metrics, providing methods to validate project solutions, deliver measurable and validated results and develop control plans to ensure project gains are continuous and sustainable.

- Serving as an internal consultant on assigned projects to assist with identifying improvement opportunities and providing recommendations that includes defining Voice of the Customer, overseeing data collection, analysis, testing.

- Collaborating with TJX Europe departments where there is impact to operational efficiencies, analysing data based on metrics, providing quantitative and qualitative observations, and developing recommendations based on findings.

- There is the opportunity to gain Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt qualification. Working as part of a global team, with the opportunity to collaborate and network across international and cross-functional teams

What We’re Looking For

- Working towards Bachelor’s degree in Business Management/ Engineering/Science (preferred, not essential)

- Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma (LSS) and DMAIC methodology; LSS Green and/or Yellow belt training an asset

- Demonstrated project management skills including structured project methodologies (i.e. determining needs, researching existing programs, etc.); utilizing multiple sources of information to develop well-structured business recommendations preparing and maintaining detailed development plans for projects; determining project specifications; understanding and applying principles of project control; and knowledge of and ability to use project reporting systems

- Good analytical and critical thinking skills to provide solutions; ability to leverage prior experience and adapt quickly to the changing work environment to make effective decisions, revise business strategies to support the vision of the organization

- Demonstrated problem solving skills including analysis of information (i.e. requirements; description of problems.); provide solutions with cost implications to effectively resolve issues and execute strategic solutions

- Good organizational development skills including change management, time management; ability to implement and manage details, prioritize, multi-task and sometimes work under time pressure; ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Excellent presentation, interpersonal and communication skills; ability to read, write and interpret information accurately.

- Ability to develop and build relationships with internal and external partners, influence team members and help prioritize activities and resources to meet the organization’s needs; build rapport and credibility to be a trusted advisor

- Demonstrated people management skills including coaching, providing advice and guidance to Associates to resolve issues/problems, evaluating performance and providing feedback to team members.

- Good understanding of financial planning, business tools and reports to make business recommendations

Skills/Knowledge
- Strong computer skills including Ms Office – Word, Excel and PowerPoint  Knowledge/experience of PowerBI and Visio would also be an asset

- PowerPoint, Access; VBA and SharePoint knowledge/experience an asset.

- Ability to analyze, interpret and present data, Using datasets, charts and tables to communicate findings in a digestible form

- Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable results

- Problem solving ability- Lean or Six Sigma

- Interact and partner with all levels of the organization

- Project Management

What we offer
At TJX Europe, we believe in supporting our associates to thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what you can expect:
- Generous holiday allowance plus bank holidays

- Exclusive employee discounts at TK Maxx and Homesense

- Ongoing learning and development opportunities

- A collaborative, inclusive culture where your voice is valued

- Access to wellbeing support and resources

- Pension and life assurance schemes

- Opportunities to grow your career across our global business

- Hybrid working model with flexibility

- A vibrant, campus-style head office in the heart of Watford—featuring a subsidised canteen, onsite gym, free parking, and just a short walk from Watford Junction Station

Application Process
Online application > Psychometric Online Tests > Online Video Interview > Assessment Centre or In Person Interview
You must have the legal right to work in the country you are applying to.

As proud as we are of our past success, it’s our future that excites us most. We strive to provide opportunities for growth, recognition and a competitive salary and benefits package. Share our determination to think bolder and bigger, and be part of our future. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnerships, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and/or sexual orientation.

Job Description:
Finance Manager | Business Planning & Analysis

Want to make an impact?
As part of our team at TJX, you will manage a team of Financial Analysts & Senior Financial Analysts to assist Senior Leadership with driving business decisions and supporting strategic financial initiatives for a multibillion-dollar business line. Your day-to-day will present challenges to drive impact for the leading off-price retailer in the world.

A successful candidate will work on multiple projects simultaneously that will be reviewed by Senior Executives. Further, you be asked to think critically, analyze effectively, and communicate efficiently.

Responsibilities include:
- Managing the processes and activities of the finance division to ensure effective, efficient, and accurate reporting and analytics
- Leading and overseeing workloads to ensure time critical projects are delivered as expected
- Driving the development of analytical models to forecast and understand short- and long-term trends
- Responsible for driving analysis to provide relevant Executive Level guidance on business performance and areas of risk and opportunity
- Coordinating / Performing standard reporting with excellent attention to detail
- Playing a leadership role on projects & new initiatives
- Delivering strategy and recommendations on various initiatives across all levels of Management
- Managing and mentoring associates with training and professional development
- Building relationships with operational partners across the business

Requirements:
- 5+ years of relevant experience in Corporate Finance, FP&A, Public Accounting, Consulting, Investment Banking or other related fields
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics or Accounting preferred; MBA a plus
- Prior experience leading teams in a dynamic, fast paced environment with a focus on associate training and development
- Proven proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel and PowerPoint presentation development skills; ability to develop robust interactive excel models independently
- Excellent communications skills with the ability to deliver insights, recommendations, and results concisely and effectively to Executive Level management
- Ability to work with ambiguity, removing obstacles and maintaining focus in complicated situations to deliver results for self and team
- Promotes collaboration within team & cross-functionally and actively finds opportunities for improvements

Benefits include Associate discount; 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long-term disability; paid holidays/vacation /sick/bereavement/parental leave; EAP; incentive programs for management; auto/home insurance discounts; tuition reimbursement; scholarship program; adoption/surrogacy assistance; smoking cessation; child care/cell phone discounts; pet/legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. All benefits are subject to applicable plan or program terms (including eligibility terms) and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

Job Description:
Financial Planning & Analysis Manager

Identifies and develops short- and long-term strategies and provides recommendations for profit and productivity improvements within Store Operations. Provides ongoing financial and operational analysis to identify and focus Senior Management on profit challenges and opportunities. Supports the planning, management, and optimization of the Store Operations payroll budget, ensuring alignment between financial objectives and operational execution. Develops and fosters cross-functional partnerships with Store Operations, Zone teams, and other business partners to support initiatives that drive profit, productivity, and operational effectiveness.

Major Areas of Responsibility
- Provides research, analysis, and coordination of projects related to store tests, new initiatives, and underperforming store/market initiatives. This role analyzes performance, identifies areas of opportunity, works with various business partners, and makes fact-based recommendations.
- Researches and identifies potential profit and productivity improvement initiatives through both financial and operational analysis, focusing on maximizing the effectiveness of the payroll investment, improving units per hour, and optimizing non-payroll expenses.
- Supports the planning, forecasting, analysis, and management of the $3.5B Store Operations payroll budget, including evaluation of labor investments, workforce productivity, staffing requirements, and payroll trends to ensure alignment with financial and operational objectives.
- Partners closely with Zone leadership teams to develop, evaluate, and execute labor and productivity strategies, providing financial insights and recommendations that balance customer experience, operational needs, and payroll efficiency.
- Provides ad hoc analytical capability and support to Store Operations Senior Management, Regional Management, Zone leadership, and others as required.
- Provides analytic support to assess & influence the annual financial plans and execute in partnership with the field organization
- Develops reporting, analyses, and performance metrics to monitor payroll spending, labor productivity, and execution against financial plans, identifying risks and opportunities and recommending corrective actions where needed.

What we are Looking for
- Bachelor Degree in Accounting or Finance, MBA in Finance or Accounting preferred
- 5+ years of relevant finance/accounting experience
- Prior experience leading a team
- Understanding of budget and financial analysis techniques, accounting principles and familiarity with systems development.
- Knowledge of interfacing and managing within a large decentralized field organization and store operation practices.
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, presentation, and managerial skills.
- Excellent knowledge of multi-dimensional cube technology is preferred (COGNOS, BPC, Hyperion).

jobs.title: General Manager Amsterdam
jobs.description:
TK Maxx
At TJX Europe, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritises your development. Whether you’re working in our Distribution Centers, Corporate Offices, or Retail Stores—TK Maxx & Homesense, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX team—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:
Van creaties die rechtstreeks vanaf de catwalk komen tot sieraden die uitblinken, we hebben een dagelijks veranderend assortiment. Dat is een hele andere manier van shoppen, het is schatzoeken. Een hele andere winkelervaring die gaat over het vreugdemomentje waarop je precies dat ene juweeltje vindt. Over de spannende verrassingen die het dagelijks leven een beetje leuker maken. Zo is het ook met werken bij TK Maxx. Ook onze werkomgeving verandert constant. Elke dag is er een nieuwe kans om iets nieuws te ontdekken. Discover Different.

Wat is TK Maxx                                                                                                         TK Maxx is een warenhuis. Hier vind je alles wat je van een warenhuis mag verwachten: beautyproducten, kleding, schoenen, speelgoed en interieur styling. In ons warenhuis zorg jij ervoor dat onze klanten blij zijn.  Voor onze winkelmanagement betekent dit dat elke dag anders is, omdat ook onze leveringen elke dag anders zijn.

General Manager                                                                                                          Als General Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de performance van jouw TK Maxx eigen warenhuis. Samen met de Deputy General Manager en Assistent Store Manager(s) houd je je bezig met coaching en ontwikkeling van je team. Samen laten jullie het team zien hoe je klanten blij maakt. Maar ook hoe je de continuiteit van het warenhuis kunt waarboren en altijd de mooiste presentaties hebt.
Samen met de District Manager definieer je de doelen voor jouw warenhuis en samen met je Deputy General Manager, Assistenten en Teamleiders voer je deze uit in de praktijk. Samen maak je jouw collega’s elke dag een beetje beter.

Je komt het beste tot je recht in deze functie wanneer je:
- Een aantal jaar meerdere teams hebt aangestuurd in de rol van Regiomanager, District Manager of Clustermanager.
- Flexibel kunt zijn en van een werkomgeving houdt waarin veel gebeurd.
- Geen moeite om een gesprek aan te gaan in het Nederlands of Engels.

Wat ga je bij ons doen?
Jij bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de verkoop,  het behalen van de KPI’s en het bewaken van de budgetten;
- Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de personeelsplanning en het personeelsbeleid waarbij werving en selectie, verzuim, coaching, het streven naar een optimale bezetting en een goede productiviteit een grote rol spelen;
- Jij bent een voorbeeld voor jouw managers en team. Jij motiveert, inspireert en ontwikkelt jouw team door training en coaching on ‘the job’;
- Jij bewaakt het offprice model. Met jouw commerciële inzicht , creativiteit en productkennis ziet het warenhuis er altijd representatief uit.

Wat krijg je van ons?
- Een contract met vaste uren (38 per week)
- Een aantrekkelijk salaris.
- Een prestatiegerelateerde bonus.
- 8% vakantiegeld.
- 24 vakantiedagen o.b.v. 38 uur.
- Tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten vanaf 10 km.
- Volop trainingen en opleidingen, zowel digitaal, als klassicaal of op de werkvloer.
- Een arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket inclusief pensioen, gezondheidszorg en levensverzekering.
- Personeelskorting.
- Doorgroeimogelijkheden, zowel nationaal als internationaal.

Bij ons is diversiteit geen trend, maar iets wat al meer dan 40 jaar het fundament is van onze organisatie. Vanzelfsprekend zijn sollicitaties van iedereen welkom. We maken geen onderscheid op basis van leeftijd, handicap, geslacht, geslachtsverandering, huwelijk en geregistreerd partnerschap, zwangerschap en moederschap, ras, religie of overtuiging en/of seksuele geaardheid
